For every isomorphic mapping \(f\) on a Hilbert space \(X\), there exists a linear structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that guarantees convergence \(T_f^n \to T_{\mathcal{S}}\) in the metric topology.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the rigid operator \(T_{1500011}\) acting on the separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the rigid-separable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1500011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1500011}\).

Step 2. Consider the algebraic operator \(T_{1500012}\) acting on the incomplete space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the algebraic-incomplete decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1500012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1500012}\).

Step 3. Consider the expansive operator \(T_{1500013}\) acting on the Borel space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the expansive-Borel decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1500013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1500013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via isometric interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1500011} \cdot C_{1500012} \cdot C_{1500013}\).
